recentItems.title: Israel Elections Explained | Times Now Worldview With Akanksha Swarup | Episode 1
recentItems.description:
Protests in the square. A tight race. And a nation deciding between continuity and accountability. Israel heads to the polls on   October 27... And its streets are telling you what this election is really about. This is in the lead-up to Israel's first general election since the war on Gaza began. But it was not just an anti-government protest. It's a demand for accountability - an independent state inquiry into the security failures that led to the October 7, 2023 attacks. Watch Akanksha Swarup explain the contenders, and why this election - Israel's sixth in seven years - is being called its most pivotal.
